caption: The drawing is a technical line drawing on beige paper, featuring three main views of a chair: a front view, a side view, and a top view. All lines and numbers appear in a faint blue-grey pencil or ink. The chair is depicted with curved front legs and a prominent, decorative splat in the center of the backrest. Dashed guide lines are used to indicate symmetry and align various dimensions. Dimensions are provided throughout, including seat height, width, and overall height. The title area in the top right reads "CHAIR from BLISS HOUSE," with additional notation: "No. 17603-R BKLYN MUSEUM ARTHUR JOHNSON ARTIST," followed by "SCALE 1/8" = 1'." The chair frame is boxy with slight curves and includes detailed measurements for most elements, such as the seat size and leg positions. The overall composition presents the object in a precise and measured format, without any shading or color other than the base tone of the paper and the blue-grey of the lines.
title: Side Chair
